core.title: Wide Door Overhead Concealed Door Stop, Don-Jo 3024-630
tags: stainless steel Overhead Door Stop and Holder

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 3024-630, Overhead Concealed Door Stop

Brushed stainless steel concealed overhead door stop. Track mounts Concealed (hidden in top of door); to a metal doors top rail or mortised top of wood doors. An internal spring cushions the door opening.

Also available: Don-Jo 3023 Overhead Concealed Door Stop.

For interior single or double acting doors. Non-handed.

Specifications for the Don-Jo 3024-630 Overhead Concealed Door Stop:

  • Track Length: 16-3/4"
  • Track Width: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Opening Distance: 110 Degrees
  • Fasteners: Two (2) #10 x 1-1/2" machine screws, Four (4) #10-32 x 1/2" machine screws, Four (4) #10 1-1/2" wood screws
  • Non-Handed
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo 3024 Dimensions (PDF)

For use on 36" - 48" wide doors.
*Measure your door opening

  • Standard Butt Hinges: Door opening width 35" - 48"
  • Center Hung Pivot: Door opening width 38" - 48"
For narrow door openings use: Don-Jo 3023 Overhead Concealed Door Stop.

*Sold Individually.
